description.en: The business extension information. The default value is an empty collection.

description.zh: 导入的流程DSL数据，即为一段JSON格式的数据，您可提前在流程编辑器画布中编排好流程组件，保存后单击画布编排右上角**设置**>**导出**为一个JSON格式数据文件进行查看。
description.en: The flow DSL data to import. This is a block of data in JSON format. To obtain this data, arrange the components on the canvas in the Flow Editor, save the flow, and then click **Settings** > **Export** in the upper-right corner of the canvas. The flow is exported as a JSON data file.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口创建并导入流程，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动创建并导入流程。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有导出的流程DSL数据。

- 若您没有已导出的流程DSL数据，可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面进行画布组件编排，保存后并导出为JSON格式的数据文件。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to create and import a flow. You can also create and import a flow manually in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

- Before you call this operation, ensure that you have exported the Domain-Specific Language (DSL) data for the flow.

- If you do not have the exported DSL data for a flow, go to the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder). Click a flow name to open the canvas. Arrange the components on the canvas, save the flow, and then export it as a JSON data file.
